name: Run time and queue time
description:
Shows: P50 and P95 of duration_s (started to finished) and P95 of queue_s (dispatched to started) per agent. Reads run.finished.
Why it matters: How long an issue waits and how long it takes to turn into a PR: the factory's lead time. Rising run time points to bloated context or slow models; rising queue time to runner or concurrency limits.
